description: Defines an enumeration with constants and methods related to Bonjour service types and domain normalization for the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resolveWideAreaDomain
methods.description: Resolves the wide area domain from an environment variable, returning a normalized domain or nil.

methods.name: normalizeServiceDomain
methods.description: Normalizes a raw domain string by trimming, converting to lowercase, and ensuring proper suffix format.
